options.name: accountingPort
options.description: Valid Range 1 to 65535.

options.name: authenticationPort
options.description: Valid Range 1 to 65535.

options.name: authenticatorKey
options.description: The authenticatorKey is required only if enableKeyWrap is true, otherwise it must be ignored or empty. The maximum length is 20 ASCII characters or 40 HEXADECIMAL characters (depend on selection in field 'keyInputFormat').

options.name: description
options.description: Description.

options.name: enableKeyWrap
options.description: KeyWrap may only be enabled if it is supported on the device. When running in FIPS mode this option should be enabled for such devices.

options.name: encryptionKey
options.description: The encryptionKey is required only if enableKeyWrap is true, otherwise it must be ignored or empty. The maximum length is 16 ASCII characters or 32 HEXADECIMAL characters (depend on selection in field 'keyInputFormat').

options.name: hostIP
options.description: The IP of the host - must be a valid IPV4 address.

options.name: id
options.description: Id.

options.name: ise_debug
options.description: Flag for Identity Services Engine SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: ise_hostname
options.description: The Identity Services Engine hostname.

options.name: ise_password
options.description: The Identity Services Engine password to authenticate.

options.name: ise_single_request_timeout
options.description: Timeout (in seconds) for RESTful HTTP requests.

options.name: ise_username
options.description: The Identity Services Engine username to authenticate.

options.name: ise_uses_api_gateway
options.description: Flag that informs the SDK whether to use the Identity Services Engine's API Gateway to send requests. If it is true, it uses the ISE's API Gateway and sends requests to https://{{ise_hostname}}. If it is false, it sends the requests to https://{{ise_hostname}}:{{port}}, where the port value depends on the Service used (ERS, Mnt, UI, PxGrid).

options.name: ise_uses_csrf_token
options.description: Flag that informs the SDK whether we send the CSRF token to ISE's ERS APIs. If it is True, the SDK assumes that your ISE CSRF Check is enabled. If it is True, it assumes you need the SDK to manage the CSRF token automatically for you.

options.name: ise_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: ise_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Identity Services Engine to use.

options.name: ise_wait_on_rate_limit
options.description: Flag for Identity Services Engine SDK to enable automatic rate-limit handling.

options.name: keyInputFormat
options.description: Specifies the format of the input for fields 'encryptionKey' and 'authenticatorKey'. Allowed Values ASCII or HEXADECIMAL.

options.name: msgAuthIsRequiredOnResponse
options.description: Should ISE validate the existence of Message-Authenticator on responses from the eternal RADIUS server.

options.name: name
options.description: Name.

options.name: proxyTimeout
options.description: Valid Range 1 to 600.

options.name: retries
options.description: Valid Range 1 to 9.

options.name: sharedSecret
options.description: Shared secret maximum length is 128 characters.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Valid Range 1 to 120.
